fact: Lesotho Times reports that the Minister of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation signed the Broadband Infrastructure Sharing Policy at a ceremony held 'yesterday' relative to the 12 June 2026 article, so on 11 June 2026; no plan period is given.
The Minister of Finance and Development Planning told Parliament on 19 February 2025 that key policies under development include Artificial Intelligence, Broadband and Data Management.

The Government of Lesotho (MICSTI) held a second draft of the Broadband and Shared Infrastructure Policy and Implementation Plan, with a monitoring and evaluation framework, dated by the proxy publish date of 17 February 2025; the document states no plan period and says formal broadband legislation is lacking.
